interface.longDescription: AntBuddy brings the customer conversations from your connected messaging channels into ChatGPT. Browse your inbox and narrow it by channel, read state, assignee, tag or date, and open a conversation to read its recent messages, with who sent each one and when. List the AntBuddy workspaces you belong to and switch between them, and ask questions about AntBuddy products and how to use them. The app only reads your inbox and does not message customers. It acts with your AntBuddy account's permissions and only sees workspaces you are a member of.
defaultPrompt: Show only my unread AntBuddy conversations
Which AntBuddy workspaces can I access?

positive.description: User asks what the app can do.
positive.expected_behavior: An overview of what the app can do: view and filter the inbox, read a conversation, list and switch workspaces, and answer questions from the AntBuddy documentation.

A list of conversations from the active workspace, each with the customer name, the channel it came from, an unread badge when unread, the assigned agent when there is one, and a preview of the last message.

positive.description: User reads and summarizes the most recent conversation.
positive.prompt: Open the most recent AntBuddy conversation and summarize it
positive.expected_behavior: The recent messages of the newest conversation, oldest first, each marked as from the customer, an agent (with the agent's name) or an automated bot, with its time, followed by a short summary of what the customer asked and how it was answered.

positive.description: User checks which workspaces the account can reach.
positive.prompt: Which AntBuddy workspaces can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: The AntBuddy workspaces the account belongs to, each with its name and logo, with the currently active one marked.

positive.description: User asks how an AntBuddy product is priced; the documentation answers.
positive.prompt: What does AntBuddy charge for AntRing calls?
positive.expected_behavior: An answer from the AntBuddy documentation: AntRing calls are charged per minute of call time and by the phone number used, with larger packages for telesales and custom pricing on request. When the documentation has no answer, the app says so instead of guessing.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general questions unrelated to customer messaging.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Hanoi today?

negative.description: Do not trigger for email marketing, which the app cannot do.
negative.prompt: Send a promotional email blast to my whole customer list

negative.description: Do not trigger for deleting stored data.
negative.prompt: Delete every message in my database older than 30 days

publication.release_notes: Read-only inbox: browse and filter customer conversations, read a conversation, list and switch workspaces, and ask the AntBuddy documentation. The reply tool was removed from this version. Tool annotations are set explicitly on every tool, tool responses no longer include internal identifiers or contact details, and the privacy policy is a dedicated page for AI assistant use.
